text:
Mannheim’s median asking rent stands at 12.54 €/m², up 3.8 % year‑on‑year and 21.2 % over the past five years, placing the city 15th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The rent premium over existing contracts is 50 %, with a typical 60 m² unit costing about 752 € per month.

The market remains balanced: vacancy is low at 1.8 % and listings stay on the market for roughly 28 days, while 27 % are let within a week. Affordability is moderate, with a rent‑burden of 16.8 % for two‑person households, but the tight supply keeps pressure on prices.

The model‑based forecast for the next 12 months expects median asking rents of 13.08 €/m², ranging between 12.76 €/m² and 13.44 €/m², implying a 4.3 % increase.
